integrationsCatalog.title: Integrations
integrationsCatalog.description: Connect Topiqu to services for measurement, distribution, and publishing.
integrationsCatalog.gscDescription: Turn search performance into concrete content opportunities.
integrationsCatalog.gscBenefitOne: See article queries, clicks, CTR, and average positions.
integrationsCatalog.gscBenefitTwo: Topiqu identifies content near top positions and unusually low CTR.
integrationsCatalog.gscStepOne: Connect a Google account with Search Console access.
integrationsCatalog.gscStepTwo: Choose the property that belongs to this website.
integrationsCatalog.gscStepThree: Topiqu starts syncing finalized performance data every day.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsDescription: Add your own GA4 measurement to the website published by Topiqu.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsBenefitOne: Traffic data remains in your own Google Analytics property.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsBenefitTwo: Enable measurement without editing templates or source code.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsStepOne: In Google Analytics, open Admin → Data streams.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsStepTwo: Copy the Measurement ID in the G-XXXXXXXXXX format.
integrationsCatalog.analyticsStepThree: Enable measurement, enter the ID, and save your changes.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinDescription: Publish approved content to your personal LinkedIn profile.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinBenefitOne: Approved posts go straight to your personal profile.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinBenefitTwo: Human in the Loop keeps approval control before publishing.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinStepTwo: Grant Topiqu the requested LinkedIn access.
integrationsCatalog.linkedinStepThree: Configure the publishing mode and brand guidelines.
integrationsCatalog.developerDescription: Tools for custom development and publishing workflows outside the external services catalog.
integrationsCatalog.apiBenefitOne: Connect a custom app, automation, or editorial workflow.
integrationsCatalog.apiBenefitTwo: Regenerate the single secure access key whenever needed.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressDescription: Topiqu Sync imports published articles as native WordPress posts.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressBenefitOne: Move published content without manual copying.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressBenefitTwo: Articles remain native WordPress posts on your website.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressStepOne: Install and activate the Topiqu Sync plugin in WordPress.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressStepTwo: Enter your Topiqu URL and the API key from this page.
integrationsCatalog.wordpressStepThree: Test the connection and configure the synchronization interval.
